verdict.rationale: WorkOS Directory Sync documents SCIM support, alongside dozens of other directory integrations, with automatic updates for directory, group, user and access-rule changes. Those updates arrive via webhooks or the Events API, and IT admins can activate and deactivate accounts. Community users independently praise how easy WorkOS makes SCIM configuration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that IdP deactivation automatically revokes active app sessions (the evidence implies the app must act on the delivered events), and detailed hands-on corroboration of the deprovisioning flow.
